description.text: Grants [Attach Wind with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Vaan], [Apex Pyroclasm Ability Tracker] and [Apex Pyroclasm Level]

description.name: Attach Wind with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Wind Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Wind 3

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Vaan
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Apex Pyroclasm (0~2), removed after using Apex Pyroclasm two times

description.name: Apex Pyroclasm Ability Tracker
description.text: Increases Apex Pyroclasm level by 1 after using 5 or 8 Wind abilities during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Vaan]

description.name: Apex Pyroclasm Level
description.text: Keeps track of Apex Pyroclasm level (0~2), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Vaan]
